items.title: Exercise 6 · the upper Gaussian-mixture coupling

source.anchor: Statistical Optimal Transport, July 2024 preface, Chapter 1 §1.8 Exercise 6 upper hint, printed p.44 / PDF p.50
source.attribution: Sinho Chewi, Jonathan Niles-Weed and Philippe Rigollet, Statistical Optimal Transport. Original ASTIS restatement of the exercise and explicit completion of the upper hint, not quoted prose or author endorsement.

items.statement: In Exercise 6, for m>0, compare the quadratic Wasserstein distance of two actual unit-variance Gaussian mixtures with m by constants independent of m. The first law weights the centers −m and m equally; the second weights them 1/4 and 3/4 respectively. The upper hint asks for a feasible coupling. The lower hint asks for an expectation comparison through W₁ and W₁≤W₂.
assumptions: The ambient space is the Borel real line. N(a,1) has mean a and variance one; the variance-one convention describes each component, not the mixture.

The source assumes m>0. The exact upper witness and squared bound hold for every real m, since the witness cost depends on m². No bounded support, supplied coupling, assumed cost, or optimality condition is imposed.

formulae.label: The exercise target, not all closed

obligations.label: Exhibit a coupling of the two actual mixtures with squared cost m²
Prove and use the lower expectation comparison via W₁≤W₂
Assemble both sides with constants uniform in m>0

bindings.boundary: Only the upper-bound feasible witness with its exact two marginals and finite quadratic cost. No optimality, lower bound, full numbered exercise, Bench admission, graph certificate, or release is claimed.

assumption_deltas.source: Real Gaussians of unit component variance, weighted on the means −m,m with m>0.
assumption_deltas.lean: Same literal Gaussian laws and weights on the real line; this exact-cost feasible plan is constructed for every real m.
assumption_deltas.reason: The affine shared-noise maps are defined for all m and their squared cost uses only m². The positive-m restriction is retained when reading the full two-sided source result.

source_proof_coverage.coverage_status: Source topology accepted for U1 only; separate lower direction and complete exercise remain open.
